item.title: Last remaining three-car class 110 heads for new home in Wales
item.description: The Llangollen and Corwen Railway is set to add a distinctive Yorkshire-built railcar to its fleet with the acquisition of the last remaining three-car Class 110 Diesel Multiple Unit.

item.title: Apedale to welcome Motor Rail Mania guest locomotives this summer
item.description: Apedale Valley Light Railway's Motor Rail Mania is gearing up for an exciting weekend on June 27 - 28, with the announcement of its first two visiting locomotives.

item.title: UK’s first HydroShunter unveiled at Severn Valley Railway
item.description: Vanguard Sustainable Transport Solutions and Severn Valley Railway have marked a significant step forward in railway decarbonisation with the official market launch of the UK’s first hydrogen-powered railway shunting locomotive. The HydroShunter was unveiled at Kidderminster Town station on Thursday, 26 February, showcasing a practical pathway to zero-emission shunting.

item.title: New OO gauge steam locomotive models bring back memories of West Country branch lines
item.description: Rapido Trains is releasing a range of OO Gauge versions of GWR ‘Small Prairie’ 45xx Class 2-6-2 tank engines.

item.title: Northampton and Lamport Railway to celebrate with Easter Egg Specials
item.description: The Northampton and Lamport Railway (NLR) is inviting families to celebrate Easter in style with its popular Easter Egg Specials, running on Sunday, 5th and Monday, 6th April. Visitors can enjoy scenic train rides through the Northamptonshire countryside, with departures every hour from 10 am to 3 pm on both days

item.title: Two locomotives set to visit Ravenglass for Northern Rock’s Golden Jubilee Gala
item.description: Between 2 and 4 May, two guest locomotives from the Whistlestop Valley are set to visit the Ravenglass and Eskdale Railway, attending Northern Rock's Golden Jubilee Gala.

item.title: New OO gauge pre-grouping GWR lined crimson lake carriages
item.description: Rapido Trains has announced a range of Great Western Railway Crimson Lake liveried pre-Grouping coaching stock.

item.title: Return for new Dockland’s Light Railway trains announced
item.description: Passengers on the Docklands Light Railway can expect the return of its new trains by late summer, as Transport for London (TfL) and manufacturer CAF continue to make solid progress on detailed investigations, testing and assurance.

item.title: Severn Valley Railway to support new multi-sport challenge this summer
item.description: The Severn Valley Railway is supporting a brand-new multisport challenge, Steaming Down the Valley, at the Severn Valley Country Park, set to take place on Saturday, 6 June 2026.
